tools.name: search_investors
tools.description: Search 58,000+ angel investors and VCs in AngelBacked. Filter by free text (name, firm, title), market/sector, location, or a company they backed. Returns id, name, title, firm, city/state/country, markets, portfolio_count, LinkedIn/Twitter/website, profile_url and has_email. Emails are not included

tools.name: get_investor
tools.description: Full profile for one investor by id or slug (from search results or an angelbacked.co/investor/<slug> URL): title, firm, location, markets, social links and up to 100 portfolio companies. No email; use reveal_investor_email.

tools.name: company_investors
tools.description: Angel investors in AngelBacked who backed a named company (exact company name, case-insensitive), most active first, up to 50. Use it to find investors who already back companies like yours.

tools.name: reveal_investor_email
tools.description: Reveal one investor's email address. Uses the account's email reveal allowance (the same one as the Reveal button on angelbacked.co; Annual: 500 per day, 3,000 per 30 days). Revealing an investor the account has already revealed is free. Only reveal investors the user intends to contact.

tools.name: recent_funding_rounds
tools.description: Recent startup funding rounds tracked by AngelBacked Signals: company, date, stage, amount and industry, newest first. Filter by days back (max 180), industry and stage (e.g. "Seed", "Series A", "Pre-Seed").

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_investors, get_investor · Private data: search_investors, reveal_investor_email · Public sink: get_investor, reveal_investor_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_investors, get_investor · Private data: search_investors, reveal_investor_email · Public sink: get_investor, reveal_investor_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
